svg.aria-label: A Ghostty terminal running herdr with Catppuccin Mocha. A zsh session types tree of the dotfiles repo, whoami, cat .plan (UCF Computer Science May 2028, SWE Intern at Versant Media on Rotten Tomatoes, open to Summer 2027 SWE internships), ls ~/projects, cat wins.txt (CrisisLens 1st in the Databricks Challenge at Hacklytics 2026, Farsight 4 sponsor tracks at Knight Hacks IX, Backrooms Hyphenate prize at Cal Hacks 13.0), and gh pr list for 3 merged badges/shields PRs.
